svg.aria-label: Engineering Tech Radar Q2 2026 — Tech-radar diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Tech radar of 15 entries across 4 quadrants, Techniques, Tools, Platforms and Languages & Frameworks, in 4 rings, Adopt, Trial, Assess and Hold.
